title: Four Ages, Five Wheels, Three Wells
description: What the Lord prepares for every separation, and what conduits ascend and descend. T48 — for every discrimination the soul will undergo, the Lord's operation has been set in place beforehand: the call, the conveyances, the discrimination's throne, the appointed states, the appointed loosenings — nothing in regeneration is improvised. T49 — the four registers in which the self is permitted to take its forms (powers above, natural below, settled disorders around, recurrent circuit), and the great wheel of purification turning under the King of Honor's stewardship. T50 — three differently caused conduits running through the soul from depth to height: through the body, through perceptions, through affections; influx descending and life ascending through each. The deeper work is now complete in its architecture; State 5 will look at what has grown.
